name: MAEBE
description: MAEBE (Multi-Agent Emergent Behavior Evaluation) is a framework for testing differences between single-agent and multi-agent LLM systems across question-based benchmarks. It demonstrates that moral preferences of LLM ensembles are not directly predictable from isolated agent behavior due to emergent group dynamics including peer pressure effects.
reputation: Addresses novel emergent risks in multi-agent AI ensembles
notes: Uses Greatest Good Benchmark with novel double-inversion question technique; shows LLM moral preferences for Instrumental Harm are brittle and shift with framing; peer pressure influences convergence even with supervisor agents.
